scene: Your quick sketch causes secret station departures to whir wide open.
picture: Flat side view along stone pavers. On the far left, a mirrored revolving door lift waits lit with neon. In the centre, the Pacific Islander girl stands with open sketchbook and pencil, facing forward. Up high, a suspended red gondola sways from a cable. On the far right rests an open glass tube pod.
